_comment: DRISHTI Prompt 24 - resolved environment-specific deploy config (placeholders from gpu-worker-infra.json filled at deploy time). No secrets/credentials. Account id appears in ARNs (standard, not a credential).
instance_gpu: 1x NVIDIA T4 (Turing sm_75), 16 GB VRAM, 4 vCPU, 16 GB RAM
instance_type_rationale: T4 runs the real TabFM + TimesFM 2.5-200m within 16 GB, and g4dn.xlarge is the cheapest GPU endpoint instance, which matters while every GPU quota in this account is 0 and has to be raised by request. Descriptor default ml.g5.xlarge (A10G) is preferred once quota allows.

_BLOCKED.ec2_gpu_quota: 'Running On-Demand G and VT instances' = 0.0 vCPU in ap-south-1 and us-east-1, so the raw-EC2 fallback is equally blocked

_BLOCKED.note: Steps 1-4 (ECR repo, S3 model plane, KMS CMK, IAM role, CodeBuild image, staged artifacts) are NOT GPU-gated and can be completed while these are pending. Only create-endpoint needs the quota.
_BLOCKED.not_a_credits_problem: Credits do not lift a service quota; this is an AWS Support approval on a new account and GPU requests are sometimes declined outright.

ecr.encryption_note: ECR AES256 (AWS-managed) at rest; the KMS CMK is used for the S3 model/async-IO artifacts where the descriptor emphasises KMS.
ecr.image_note: NOT YET BUILT IN THIS ACCOUNT. Build with: $env:AWS_PROFILE='prajwal-sso'; python infra/aws/gpu-worker/codebuild_image.py deploy. Tag 0.2.3 is the last known-good source revision (0.2.3 fixed the TabFM licence marker; 0.2.2 fixed serve quoting; 0.2.1 added serve; 0.2.0 lacked serve). The digest below must be captured from THIS account's ECR - an image digest from the old account 860510875713 is not resolvable here.

prior_account_digests_do_not_reuse._note: Recorded for provenance only. These live in account 860510875713 and cannot be pulled by this account's SageMaker execution role.

kms._note: Create in step 2; sagemaker_ops.py reads key_arn for the async output KMS config.

s3.lifecycle: async-io/ objects expire after 7 days; noncurrent after 3; abort incomplete MPU after 2

iam.scope: ECR pull (worker repo only), S3 get/put/list (model-plane bucket only), KMS decrypt/generateDataKey (CMK only), SageMaker CloudWatch logs, PutMetricData

sagemaker._naming_note: Fresh account, so the plain names are free. The old account had to use the '2' suffix because failed 0.2.0/0.2.1 images left a stuck-Creating endpoint. If a create-endpoint here ever hangs in Creating, do NOT retry the same name - it blocks until terminal.

tabfm._license_note: NOT Apache-2.0. Non-commercial only - fine for this evaluation, but it is a real restriction for a police deployment and must be cleared before production use.
